question: How do higher lordly subjects arise as the knowable becomes fully or partly divided?
premises: When the entire knowable is divided, the lords of mantras and great lords arise.
When the knowable is both divided and undivided, the path up to Sadāśiva arises.
This culminates in the supreme Lord.
inference: Degrees of division in the knowable correspond to ascending levels from mantreśas to Sadāśiva and the supreme Lord.
uncertainties: The compound suśivānto@dhvoditaḥ is read as the path arisen up to Sadāśiva.
plain_english: When the whole knowable is divided, the lords of mantras and the great lords arise; when it is both divided and undivided, the path up to Sadāśiva arises, culminating in the supreme Lord.
